capture_notes: Captured sequentially in a disposable overlay through Tahoe release_capture Guest and guest helpers; no host desktop interaction.
Standard edition installer defaults were applied separately; Clipboard History was enabled for its opt-in feature photographs.

Dock material examples use native application artwork for every variant, with macOS role overrides disabled consistently. Clear and tint overlays were generated deterministically by the existing installer_themes renderer for the visible icon aliases.
The original gallery is retained with its provenance because complete-gallery staging also replaces unrelated installer photographs. These README photographs are staged separately.
The pinned profile supplied VM identity, resolution, scale and fixtures; the QML Bluetooth dependency was added only to this disposable overlay.
Capture clock was initialized from the pinned profile; elapsed times in screenshots are retained.
